title: Circle
desc: Fifty strangers, held captive and facing execution, must make an impossible decision of choosing one among them who deserves to live while the others perish.
A frustrated writer struggles to keep his family alive when a series of global catastrophes threatens to annihilate mankind.

title: Gangotri
desc: All hell breaks loose when Neelakanta finds out that his daughter is in love with his loyal lieutenant's son.

title: Fukra Gang
desc: Former delivery agents Babu and Yesu become special agents, tackling thrilling missions filled with humor, surprises, and challenges as they race toward exciting success.

title: Turbo
desc: Turbo is a garden snail who dreams of racing. After a freak accident, he gains incredible speed and races in the Indy 500, overcoming challenges with help from friends and family.

title: Srinivasa Kalyanam
desc: Srinivasa Kalyanam illustrates the sacred bond with another human through nuptial rituals and the sanctity of the institution of marriage.

title: Jhund
desc: Vijay Barse, a retired teacher, builds a football team for slum kids to keep them away from crime. He works hard to help them join a national tournament and chase their dreams.

title: Final Destination Bloodlines
desc: Teenage girl endures 1960s tower-collapse nightmares, revealed as her grandmother's premonition. The grandmother saved lives; now visions appear, urging her to stop a deadly sequence.

title: Policewala Dabang
desc: Velan, a young boy in Kattuppakkam, grows up with his half-brother Balan and a biased stepfather. Years later, robbers strike, shaking his life forever.
